0033_full_stack_foundations.notes: Large additive platform-foundation migration; table creation, backfills, indexes and capability grants must be timed on a production clone.
0033_full_stack_foundations.rollback: Restore from a verified backup or remove only newly created foundation objects after confirming no writes occurred. Published official-record revisions must never be rewritten in place.

0034_enterprise_identity_runtime.notes: Adds enterprise identity provider/link runtime objects and narrow SECURITY DEFINER pre-auth resolvers. Better Auth plugin schema remains subject to official CLI reconciliation before activation.
0034_enterprise_identity_runtime.rollback: Disable enterprise identity connections, remove provider materialization/resolvers, then drop identity runtime objects only if no external identity has been activated.

0035_enterprise_integration_completion.notes: Completes SCIM credential control-plane, durable SIS/HR/LDAPS sync staging, composite tenant/job/run integrity, object-storage-backed resumable workshop imports, and system-owned durable outbox dispatch by allowing nullable requester only on the shared jobs table. Better Auth plugin-owned schema must be reconciled from the official 1.7.2 generator before enterprise-auth activation.
0035_enterprise_integration_completion.rollback: Disable SCIM and external sync connections, revoke SCIM tokens, stop tenant workers, drain or pause system outbox dispatch, cancel/expire unfinished import batches, verify staged records are not being reconciled, then remove only 0035 application-owned objects. Do not drop Better Auth plugin-owned tables through this rollback path.

0036_public_release_cleanup.notes: Migrates the unused legacy export_jobs queue into the shared jobs table, then drops export_jobs. The migration aborts on UUID collision instead of losing history.
0036_public_release_cleanup.rollback: Restore from a verified pre-upgrade backup if the legacy queue must be recovered; do not recreate dual active queues.

0037_final_release_hardening.notes: Adds the exact seven @better-auth/scim 1.7.2 plugin models used by the configured static/application-owned SCIM mode plus a sanitized read-only platform operational-health projection. No existing application data is rewritten.
0037_final_release_hardening.rollback: Disable SCIM ingress and stop Better Auth provisioning first. Drop only empty/unreferenced SCIM plugin tables after confirming no directory has provisioned resources. Drop platform_operational_health independently; it contains diagnostic metadata only.

0038_administrator_capability_backfill.notes: Idempotently grants existing administrator roles the complete capability vocabulary so tenants created before the latest release receive new features without duplicate role rows.
0038_administrator_capability_backfill.rollback: Delete only capability rows added by this migration after confirming the corresponding features are disabled; do not remove administrator roles or pre-existing grants.

0040_platform_backup_operations.notes: Extends the existing platform operation allow-list for encrypted backup creation and verification; backup bytes and credentials remain outside the Web process.
0040_platform_backup_operations.rollback: Drain backup operations and restore the previous allow-list only after verifying no backup request is queued or running.

0041_platform_operation_controls.notes: Adds worker-mediated retry and cancellation states to the platform operation queue. Web retains INSERT/SELECT only; the privileged worker remains the sole mutator.
0041_platform_operation_controls.rollback: Drain and disable retry/cancel controls, then restore the prior queue status constraint only after no cancelled rows or control requests remain.

0042_platform_audit_explorer.notes: Adds a security-barrier, read-only projection for the platform audit explorer. The Web role receives no direct platform_audit_log privileges and audit writes remain privileged.
0042_platform_audit_explorer.rollback: Remove the audit explorer route and revoke the view grant before dropping app.platform_audit_explorer; keep the append-only platform_audit_log table intact.

0043_sanitize_platform_audit_changes.notes: Tightens the existing audit explorer projection by redacting credential-shaped values and infrastructure targets from legacy changes text before it reaches the Web role.
0043_sanitize_platform_audit_changes.rollback: Reapply the 0042 projection only after confirming the platform audit route is removed or has an equivalent application-layer redaction.

0044_fix_platform_audit_redaction.notes: Corrects the PostgreSQL replacement backreference in the existing audit projection so sensitive-key values are actually replaced rather than rendering a literal backreference.
0044_fix_platform_audit_redaction.rollback: Keep the 0043 projection if the route is removed; do not restore direct Web access to platform_audit_log.

0045_data_contract_cleanup.notes: Converts legacy text booleans to native PostgreSQL boolean and adds database-level JSON integrity constraints. Deploy only with the matching application release after validating existing values.
0045_data_contract_cleanup.rollback: Convert boolean columns back to text using CASE expressions, restore legacy boolean checks/defaults, and drop the *_json_check constraints. Take a verified backup before deployment.

0046_retire_tenant_mfa.notes: Retires MFA enrollment and trusted MFA session state for tenant users, clears legacy tenant secrets, and disables the obsolete institution policy while preserving tenantless platform-operator MFA.
0046_retire_tenant_mfa.rollback: Restore only from a verified pre-migration backup if tenant MFA is intentionally reintroduced; do not restore secrets from application logs or reconstruct encrypted enrollment state.

0047_better_auth_issuer_compatibility.notes: Completes the Better Auth 1.7.3 upgrade by relaxing the historical 1.7.0-1.7.2 account.issuer column and removing its obsolete compound unique index. Existing issuer values remain intact for audit/provenance; new Better Auth rows omit the legacy column.
0047_better_auth_issuer_compatibility.rollback: Restore only from a verified pre-migration backup if the legacy issuer constraint is intentionally reintroduced; do not recreate the compound unique index while current Better Auth 1.7.3 is active.
